note: How V01D reinvests its own money (Adam, 2026-10-15). Public by design, so ranking and plan logic only: candidates at their public list prices, learned multipliers, and which proposals were sent (id, approval id, date). No income, balance, reserve or spend amounts: tools/reinvest.mjs reads net earnings from the owner-only GET /api/earnings in memory and sends each funded item to the confirm line (order.place) with its cost, expected payback, check date and payoff-test baseline, all owner-only in D1. Metrics: sales (sale count from /api/earnings), misses (open misses from /api/misses, down is better), signups (not measured yet: nothing learned from it). Plan in docs/reinvest.md.
